lines.2: Yashi and I made eye contact.
lines.3: 「Hey. What are you doing out here, Miss Yashi? It's pretty late.」
lines.5: I'm older than her. Don't get angry. Don't get angry.
lines.7: For now, I laughed to show her what a mature adult I was.
lines.8: 「Leo Tsushima. We talked on the roof today.」
lines.11: 「Don't call me stupid. I'll crush you.」
lines.13: For some reason, I instinctively looked away.
lines.19: 「But seriously, it's dangerous for a girl to be out this late.」
lines.20: 「You should head home before some creep starts bothering you.」
lines.22: I was the mature one here.
